column3: Is it supper already?{end_wait}
...You're not the cook.{end_wait}
Hammet...{end_wait}
{actor_name:3}? Is that you?{end_wait}
And these people...\nDid they come with you?{end_wait}
Then it's begun, hasn't it,\nyour journey, {actor_name:3}?{end_wait}
I said I'd come for you.\nI meant it.{end_wait}
You shouldn't have come\ninto this place, {actor_name:3}.{end_wait}
Not another step!{end_wait}
Dodonpa...{end_wait}
What a touching reunion.\nToo bad it won't last.{end_wait}
So this is your boy,\nHammet? {actor_name:3}, is it?{end_wait}
He's barely old enough\nto hold a sword.{end_wait}
Yet he made it past\nall my guards...{end_wait}
Your guards weren't\nmuch of an obstacle.{end_wait}
Layana paid your ransom.\nWhy is Hammet still here?{end_wait}
Layana paid you?\nYou promised she'd\nget me back!{end_wait}
We're taking Hammet home.\nStand aside.{end_wait}
No. That won't be\nhappening.{end_wait}
Why settle for one ransom\nwhen Kalay keeps paying?{end_wait}
You sold him a promise\nyou never meant to keep!{end_wait}
Call me what you like.\nHammet stays here.{end_wait}
Dodonpa pulled a lever.{end_wait}
You wanted to see\nwhat's under the fortress?\nHere it is!{end_wait}
Let's see you talk\nyour way past this!{end_wait}
Still standing?\nI can fix that.{end_wait}
Dodonpa pulled a lever.{end_wait}
Come on, then!\nYou'll never get past it!{end_wait}
Go on! Feed my monster!{end_wait}
Get it off! Get it off!{end_wait}
How did he end up\nunder his own monster?{end_wait}
He tried to slip behind\nyou while it fought.{end_wait}
When his monster faltered,\nhe made his move.{end_wait}
Another moment and\nhe'd have struck you.\nFrom behind.{end_wait}
You coward!{end_wait}
Even now, you tried\nto kill us from behind.{end_wait}
All right! I'm {text_effect:2}sorry{reset_text_style}!\nJust get this thing off!{end_wait}
You want us to\nsave you now?{end_wait}
Strange. It's suddenly\nvery heavy, isn't it?{end_wait}
What do you think,\n {actor_name:1}? Do we help him?{end_now}
All right.\nHammet?{end_wait}
We can't leave him\nto die beneath it.{end_wait}
There. Try standing.\nSlowly.{end_wait}
I... I can't move.{end_wait}
Did it break your leg?{end_wait}
No. Give me a moment.\nI'll be fine.{end_wait}
Good. You're alive.{end_wait}
That's all you have\nto say to me?{end_wait}
He nearly killed us,\nand you're worried\nabout his leg?{end_wait}
He's helpless now.\nWhat good would hurting\nhim do?{end_wait}
He kept you prisoner,\nHammet!{end_wait}
I know. I haven't\nforgotten.{end_wait}
Then don't pretend\nit was nothing!{end_wait}
I'm alive, and I'm free.\nThat's enough for me.{end_wait}
It isn't enough if\nhe does this again.{end_wait}
No. It isn't.{end_wait}
Dodonpa, listen carefully.{end_wait}
He'll promise anything\nto get out of this.{end_wait}
Of course I will!\nJust let me go!{end_wait}
What would you do,\n{actor_name:2}?{end_wait}
Put him in the cell.\nLet him see it\nfrom Hammet's side.{end_wait}
No! You can't!{end_wait}
You had no trouble\ndoing it to Hammet.{end_wait}
Your call, {actor_name:1}.\nDo we lock him up?{end_now}
He made his choice.{end_wait}
Let him stay awhile.\nHe might finally learn.{end_wait}
Dad!{end_wait}
Dodonpa...\nLook what you've become.{end_wait}
I told you that cruelty\nalways finds its way\nback to its owner.{end_wait}
You will answer for\neverything you've done.{end_wait}
I let you go too far.\nI won't deny my part.{end_wait}
Then this is your fault!{end_wait}
Yes. And I'm finished\nmaking excuses for you.{end_wait}
Dad... you're not\nserious?{end_wait}
For once, I am.{end_wait}
You'll stay in this cell.\nThink about the people\nyou put here.{end_wait}
You suffered because\nof my son, didn't you?{end_wait}
No... we're safe now.{end_wait}
That doesn't make\nwhat he did right.\nI'm sorry.{end_wait}
You didn't lock me up.\nYour son did.{end_wait}
Then you can forgive me?{end_wait}
There is one thing\nwe still need from you.{end_wait}
Tell me.{end_wait}
Leave the way you came.\nDon't use the main gate.{end_wait}
But Dodonpa's locked up.\nWhy do we have to hide?{end_wait}
Your men ought to\nlet us leave now.{end_wait}
Some guards still\nanswer only to Dodonpa.{end_wait}
They won't listen to me.\nNot yet.{end_wait}
If they find Hammet,\nthey'll seize him again.{end_wait}
And if they reach\nhis cell...{end_wait}
They'll let him out.{end_wait}
Then he'll go after Kalay.\nAnd Layana.{end_wait}
Exactly. We can't\nallow that.{end_wait}
I won't have Kalay\npay for this again.{end_wait}
Go now, before my men\nrealize what's happened.{end_wait}
You mean right now?{end_wait}
I heard you'd entered.\nI spread a rumor\nthrough the fortress.{end_wait}
What rumor?{end_wait}
That thieves came for\nHammet, failed, and fled.{end_wait}
You told them that?\nWhy?{end_wait}
They've sealed this floor.\nMost guards are outside\nsearching for you.{end_wait}
So you gave us\na way out.{end_wait}
It's the least I can do.\nGo while it lasts.{end_wait}
We can get Hammet out.\nAre we ready?{end_now}
Then move. Every moment\nwe stand here risks him.{end_wait}
Next time you see my son,\nhe'll be different.\nI'll see to that.{end_wait}
I said I'll change!\nJust get me out of here!{end_wait}
